english.title: Stormproof Cities
english.description: Gathering Storm only. Every city owned by a human major civilization automatically gains Liang’s Reinforced Materials effect. Its improvements, buildings, and districts are protected from environmental damage without an assigned governor.

schinese.title: 安如磐石
schinese.description: 仅限风云变幻。人类主要文明拥有的每座城市都自动获得梁的「加固材料」效果。环境效应无法损坏这些城市的改良设施、建筑与区域，无需派驻总督。
